detections.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things.
detections.summary: As an analogy for getting out of debt, the hosts say a person at 350-400 pounds must shock their system with extreme measures like throwing out all junk food before easing up later.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A person weighing 350 to 400 pounds who wants to lose weight has to shock their system with extreme measures before they can relax to a more moderate approach.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things.
verification_candidates.rationale: A general claim about how severe obesity must be tackled, offered in passing, that could steer weight-loss approaches.
